LESSON: ENVIRONMENT SCHOOL CLEANLINESS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Environment School cleanliness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Environment School cleanliness. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how to clean the school dirty?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Practice cleanliness of school compound and classroom to facilitate healthy learning.
2. Appreciate the importance of learning in a clean compound/environment as a Muslim

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Practice cleanliness of school compound and classroom to facilitate healthy learning.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to practice cleanliness of school compound and classroom to facilitate healthy learning. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate the importance of learning in a clean compound/environment as a Muslim
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of learning in a clean compound/environment as a Muslim. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Environment School cleanliness.
2. Explain Environment School cleanliness to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

4. Show that you can: Practice cleanliness of school compound and classroom to facilitate healthy learning.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Environment School cleanliness. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how to clean the school dirty?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
